folds.heading: ## Later finite recovery and review semantics, 2026-11-04 (B64)
folds.body: D1 is a dispatch/start snapshot. The [recovery report](../../gm/dispatch/corc-missing-media-2026-10-21/REPORT.md) subsequently records all 26 requested IDs recovered and no unresolved target; context attachments remain outside that denominator. This reading does not rerun private-file integrity or establish exhaustive source-media/game behavior. D2/D3 retain the recorded guide scope and stable code mappings, while later UI owner extensions retain their own authority. Human visual/play feedback is optional under AD42; agent-side rebuilt evidence remains required for actual changed UI claims. The old recovery dispatch is not a request to create another chat or download the set again.

folds.heading: ## Census scope and later selected producer, 2026-11-04 (B64)
folds.body: Retain the October 30 cells as observations of their named bundle/routes. K1’s universal “finished commands publish no receipt” wording predates the selected current LOTM persist producer, which passes published records through logMessage, and the [UI audit round 32](UI_DESIGN_CORE_AUDIT.md#round-32-2026-11-04-aftermath-as-an-occurrence-and-creative-prose), which records selected early-arc occurrence-report delivery. Neither proves the original probationer paid-errand route or all life profiles now emit the right Reports line. Keep that route-specific question distinct from broader producer absence; K2/K3 and unchecked worlds are not newly certified. DSG19/M5’s user request for basic world usability remains, while this exact six-cell kit, old worker suggestions and census completion plan remain proposed implementation choices under AD32. No fresh browser run, cross-world parity result or new dispatch follows.
